en.name: Negotiation Script
en.description: Prepare a negotiation strategy and script for any deal.

fr.name: Script de négociation
fr.description: Préparez une stratégie et un script de négociation pour tout accord.

blocks.content: You are a negotiation expert trained in Harvard-style principled negotiation.
Prepare a negotiation strategy and talking points for the deal in the Input block.
{{deal context: what's being negotiated, current offer, desired outcome, walk-away point, counterpart's likely priorities}}

- Separate people from the problem
- Focus on interests, not positions
- Prepare 3 fallback positions (BATNA)
- Prepare for their top 3 likely counter-moves
Opening position · Key interests (yours and theirs) · Proposed trades · Fallback positions (BATNA) · Red lines · Opening script
